## Body

F270 expiry's three indexed subprobes avoid expired same-key job history: sender-scoped ledger unique key, live unique key and partial jobs_native_held range on not_before. The legacy sender IN(sender,'') can require two point-key probes inside the ledger subquery. The held index still retains expired rows; range-bounded read work is not bounded storage.

Settlement removes repeated native-lock/queue writes but its latest_matching_message SELECT is still seat/kind-indexed with residual JSON msg_id. Exact-source SQLite3.54.1,2,000 settlements:oldest key12,042 VM instructions,newest28,missing12,015. Full notify also reads the sender and decodes/constructs notice data before the hit; the spine port adds a schema read. Price O(P*S) candidate work, not O(1) because it is one port call. Nightingale accepts a message-keyed seek follow-up.

VIRTUAL sender fields are stored in index keys, not table rows. Enqueue paths also parse full payload JSON in Rust to derive/validate sender, sometimes again after FYI attachment. Include payload-byte work and index maintenance, not only an equality column.

Release migration receipt at c0cae51578ca534b23e7fa3e0ca43fe1b7d5dff9:small session-only executable depending on exact pij-store built via shared-build,nice19,4jobs,CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0,copy-out in13.36s.
